# SEK Construction
> Luxury construction and renovation on the French Riviera. Private villas, historic restorations, and specialty structures shaped with quiet precision from Èze-sur-Mer across the Côte d'Azur.

SEK Construction (SEK) is a construction and renovation atelier based in Èze, France. Slogan: L'art de construire et de rénover. The practice builds and restores high-end residences and landmarks along the French Riviera.

## Services
- New construction
- Renovation
- Historic restoration
- Specialty structures (pools, gardens, complex hillside works)

## Area served
Èze, Nice, Monaco, Cap d'Ail, Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, Mougins, La Turbie, Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat, Villefranche-sur-Mer, Saint-Rémy-de-Provence, and the wider French Riviera / Côte d'Azur.
